UX Arcade Target Contrast

Game 06 · Accessibility under pressure

Target Contrast

Shoot as many targets as you can in 30 seconds.

  • Large, clear targets score less. Small, low-contrast targets score more.
  • The website gets busier and targets disappear faster.

Accessibility note: low contrast is confined to the shooting range. Scores, controls and feedback remain readable, and keyboard aiming includes directional announcements.

UX Arcade Mega Menu Mayhem

Game 07 · Navigation under pressure

Mega Menu Mayhem

Find as many destinations as you can in 30 seconds.

  • Read the task and select the link that best matches it.
  • The labels become vaguer, but there is only one correct destination.
  • Each correct route restores two seconds, then makes the countdown run faster.
  • A wrong answer costs points and increasingly more time.

Are You Human?

Reach the website by crossing five obstacles and passing five CAPTCHA checkpoints.

  • Every checkpoint is timed. Solve it before the countdown reaches zero.
